detail.title: Data-Driven Identification of Novel Research Domains
detail.summary: Automated data science practices provide a structured mechanism for identifying research problems by synthesizing large-scale domain data. When applied to fields such as carbon-capturing technology, this approach successfully isolates alternative processes as novel research targets. This framework reduces reliance on heuristic problem identification, shifting the burden to systematic analysis.
detail.reason: Notebook revision completed to reflect current synthesis of autonomous problem identification.

children.title: Metacognitive Monitoring for Unrecognized Reasoning Limits

detail.title: Metacognitive Monitoring for Unrecognized Reasoning Limits
detail.summary: Reasoning limits are often identified when systems encounter discrepancies in foundational assumptions or environmental drift. This revision integrates findings on technological equivalency assumptions and alternative processes, highlighting that presumed stability in multi-approach systems can mask latent reasoning failure.
detail.reason: Incorporating new evidence to update reasoning limits analysis.
